title: WoobleDex
summary: All 1025 Pokémon in every game, Red to Emerald, with today's moves, abilities, items and the Fairy type.

title: WoobleSpritePack
summary: Animated, true-colour sprites for all 1025 Pokémon, from Red to Emerald.

title: WoobleSpawns
summary: Every route, cave and lake in Kanto, Johto and Hoenn gets fresh Pokémon from Generations 1 to 9, picked to fit the place.

title: WoobleView
summary: Sharp Pokémon, battles that fit any screen, and battles set in a 3D world.

title: Vivid Worlds
summary: Wild Pokémon roam the overworld of Ruby, Sapphire, Emerald, FireRed and LeafGreen. Walk up to one to battle it, and bring a partner along. Formerly Wilds of Hoenn.

title: Vivid Worlds: OG
summary: Wild Pokémon roam the overworld of Red, Blue, Yellow, Gold, Silver and Crystal, and a partner Pokémon walks with you, battles at your side and digs up treasure.

title: WoobOS
summary: The PC as a modern desktop. Boot it up, tap an app, and get on with your Pokémon.

title: Galar Rising
summary: Sword and Shield's Max Raid Battles in Ruby, Sapphire, Emerald, FireRed and LeafGreen.

title: NaviPlay
summary: A second screen for your Pokémon. Pet them, feed them, play games with them and train them, on a DS-style touch screen.

title: Terrarium2
summary: Kanto as a little world under glass: the Red, Blue and Yellow overworld as a living 3D diorama, with its own weather, its own hours and things living in it.

title: Cleaner Mod Options
summary: A tidier mod list. Hide disabled mods and mods for other games from the in-game mod menu.
